entries.title: RRB NTPC Graduate — CEN 06/2026
entries.qualification: Bachelor's degree from a recognised university or equivalent. Age generally 18–33 as on 1 January 2027, subject to eligibility and relaxation rules.
entries.note: Applications close at 11:59 PM IST on 6 November. Correction period 9–18 November 2026. Exam date not published in this verified source.

entries.title: UGC–NET — December 2026
entries.qualification: Eligibility varies by subject and category; check the official NTA UGC–NET Information Bulletin for postgraduate requirements, reserved-category rules and JRF age criteria.
entries.note: Regular applications close 28 October 2026 at 11:50 PM IST. Late applications with a ₹500 late fee are accepted 29–31 October until 11:50 PM. Correction window 2–4 November; exams scheduled 14–19 December 2026.

entries.title: UPPSC Direct Recruitment — D-6/E-1/2025
entries.qualification: Post-dependent. Check the advertisement for required degree, professional registration, experience, and age criteria.
entries.note: Applications ended 21 October 2026. The commission lists a correction/reconciliation period through 28 October; this is NOT a new application window.

entries.title: UPSC Engineering Services (Preliminary) — 2027
entries.qualification: Engineering qualifications and age criteria as specified in UPSC ESE 2027 notification.
entries.note: UPSC states the application deadline was 6 October 2026 at 6 PM. This registration is closed; the published preliminary examination date is 31 January 2027.

entries.title: Joint CSIR–UGC NET — December 2026
entries.qualification: Subject- and category-specific postgraduate qualification requirements; check the current information bulletin.
entries.note: Regular registration closes 5 November at 11:50 PM IST; late submissions with a ₹500 late fee are accepted 6–9 November, closing 11:50 PM IST. Exam dates are 19, 22 and 27 December 2026. Check the Information Bulletin for eligibility.

entries.title: BPSC 72nd Combined Competitive Examination — Prelims
entries.qualification: University degree is generally required; individual post and category eligibility conditions must be verified.
entries.note: BPSC has issued a postponement notice for the prelims. Its previously tentative 25 October date must NOT be used as a current exam date. Check the commission for a new confirmed date.
